output.review_comment: The range fixes look right: start is excluded, the end date is included, and a negative range returns -business_days_between(end, start, holidays). But the PR also adds a rule that moves Saturday holidays to the Friday before and Sunday holidays to the Monday after. The only reason given is that `test_july_fourth_week_2026` expects 4. The visible docstring says nothing about observing weekend holidays, and the PR doesn't update it. The teammate said the docstrings are the source of truth, so this looks like logic added to pass a test, not documented behaviour. It also silently applies a US federal-style observance rule to every caller, which is wrong for calendars that don't shift weekend holidays and can surprise callers who already pass the observed date. Please remove the observance logic unless the docstring specifies it, and check whether the range fix alone makes the test pass. If a test still conflicts with the docstring, raise it with the team. If observance is actually wanted, document it and make it opt-in, for example with an `observe_weekend_holidays` parameter.
